requirement: Switching the signed-in DeepSeek account must move the machine to that account fleet, not leave it heartbeating in the previous fleet

assertions.mismatch: FLEET_MISMATCH names a relay fleet_id that differs from the account-derived fleet_id
assertions.rejoin: shouldRejoin re-admits on null and on mismatch, and not when the ids agree
assertions.watch: a 60s account check re-derives the fleet key and re-pairs after a switch
